preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have multisig privileges

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable token swapping and liquidity additions. This will stop all automated token-to-ETH conversions and liquidity provision, effectively freezing transaction functionality for regular users while the owner can still transfer tokens freely.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that can toggle the swapAndLiquifyEnabled boolean. The vulnerability is that the owner can disable the automatic liquidity addition feature, which could be abused to prevent proper fee distribution or liquidity provision. The oracle expects swapAndLiquifyEnabled == false, so we need to demonstrate the owner can set it to false.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the feature, demonstrating owner privilege abuse.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the owner address from the contract (0x26f80C69737107AB4625D04Cd3411CeaD3973D73 based on constructor).
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner.
3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) on the target contract.
4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.
